snippet.title: Princes of Qing | Palace Intrigue Sim VN | Trailer
snippet.description:
Title: Princes of Qing 
Tagline: Where a misplaced poem can get you executed, and a clever story can make you Prince Consort. 
Logline: A court-political life simulation RPG where you navigate a gender-swapped Imperial court, managing reputation, sabotaging rivals, and climbing the ranks through poetry, politics, and intrigue. 
Genre: Visual Novel, Political Simulation, Management Sim, Narrative RPG Platform(s): PC via Ren'Py engine 
Target Audience: Players who enjoy complex narrative games like "Long Live the Queen," fans of C-drama palace intrigue (Story of Yanxi Palace), and strategy/simulation enthusiasts who enjoy deep systems. 
Unique Selling Proposition (USP): Blends the emotional storytelling of visual novels with the mechanical depth of grand strategy games, featuring active rival sabotage systems, and a 10-tier rank progression, all wrapped in rich Hanfu-era aesthetics.
